description: Supersede rather than hard-delete outdated findings (archived rows kept with provenance for recoverability and auditability); gate agent mutations (supersede/prune) behind confidence thresholds; surface flagged contradictions as first-class reviewable objects in a dispute review queue resolvable by human command, targeted research, or new evidence.

requirements.description: Findings must never be hard-deleted; superseded rows are archived with full provenance (superseded_by finding ID, supersession reason, timestamp, actor) for recoverability and auditability. Agent-initiated mutations (supersede, prune) are gated behind configured confidence thresholds — mutations below threshold are queued for human review rather than applied automatically. Flagged contradictions are surfaced as first-class reviewable objects in a dispute review queue, resolvable by human command, targeted research, or new evidence.
requirements.title: Contradiction Handling, Soft-Delete Audit Trail, and Confidence-Gated Agent Mutations

validation.notes: Hard-delete operation on a finding returns an error (no DELETE statement executes on the findings table)
Supersede operation writes an archived row with superseded_by, reason, timestamp, and actor fields populated
Archived (superseded) finding is retrievable by ID with status=superseded
Agent supersede request with confidence below threshold is rejected and a dispute queue entry is created instead
Agent prune request with confidence below threshold is rejected and logged for human review
Dispute queue entry schema contains: finding_id, contradiction_description, conflicting_source_ids, status (open/resolved/dismissed), created_at
Agent attempts to supersede a finding with confidence 0.3 (below threshold of 0.7); verify no supersession occurs and a dispute queue entry is created
Human operator resolves a dispute queue entry via CLI; verify the targeted finding transitions to superseded status with human actor recorded in audit trail
Verify that a full findings database export includes all superseded rows with complete provenance chains
Audit trail allows an operator to reconstruct the full history of any finding from creation through all mutations to its current state
Confidence-gated agent mutations prevent low-confidence automated changes from corrupting the findings store without human oversight

title: Contradiction Handling and Audit Trail
